module_edits.insert_after: //! Optional orchestration over the standalone analyzers; no I/O or persistence.

module_integration: Apply these one-line insertions if absent; do not copy either whole module file because root has concurrent unrelated changes.
semantics: Ground truth is explicit True/False/Unknown author metadata; Truth events update that declaration. No text entailment, chronology, intent, reader learning or knowledge is inferred.
Actor is typed Reader or Character with an exact validated manuscript.known_characters reference. A character named reader remains distinct.

Know and Knowledge uptake require matching currently known declared truth plus an explicit author knowledge attestation. Correct belief is a separate classification; unknown truth does not become falsity.

Believe, Uncertain and Forget produce distinct raw assertions; absent pairs remain Unassessed. Later truth changes reclassify current assertions as correct/false/unverified beliefs or unverified/contradicted knowledge without automatic actor learning.

Communication preserves sender, recipient, said value, explicit uptake, source evidence and prior sender/recipient event IDs. A message may disagree with sender assertion/truth; testimony does not establish truth or require speaker belief.

Unique u32 sequences define one total replay order; event vectors and scene presentation order do not determine it. Duplicate IDs/sequences, invalid references/source or impossible new knowledge assertions reject the entire pure snapshot.

Current assertions are sparse; transitions store constant-size assertion/provenance deltas, not complete state-history clones. Asymmetries compare only supplied current character pairs against explicit or Unassessed reader state.
Source validation is shared with existing author promise analysis. Public structure::author_events::AuthorSource and its wire shape are preserved through re-export.

tests.command: cargo clippy --locked --features bindings --lib --test component_author_knowledge --test component_author_events -- -D warnings

coverage: False and unknown truth, correct/false/unverified belief, explicit knowledge vs belief, truth corrections, knowledge invalidation, forgetting, repeated revelation and explicit uncertainty.
Deceptive multi-hop communication, unchanged uptake, explicit knowledge uptake, sender prior evidence and recipient direction, reader/character-reader separation.
Replay/replacement/reordering, sequence max and invalid numeric forms, duplicate/dangling references, invalid actors and atomic rejection.
Unicode BOM/astral source coordinates, UTF16 surrogate splits, stale/changed sources and explicit reanchoring, all source evidence original byte/UTF16 slices.
Strict tagged-unit deserializers reject Reader role smuggling and extra value fields on raw unit assertions while preserving public Rust/JSON variants.
Parent-owned tests/fixtures/author-knowledge.json parses and produces exactly4 states,4 unassessed pairs and expected sender provenance; existing6 promise regressions pass unchanged.
limits: Author annotations are authoritative inputs, not independently verified story truth or justified learning. Quotes establish location only; matching quoted text cannot detect all semantic staleness after surrounding edits.
One annotation replay order does not simultaneously recover diegetic and presentation chronology. Context/time-dependent propositions require distinct IDs.
Omitted actor/proposition states are unassessed; asymmetries are annotation-state differences, not suspense/entropy/intent metrics or complete manuscript coverage.
This is full snapshot replay, not persistent/incremental ingestion; duplicate events inside a snapshot are rejected, while replaying an identical snapshot is idempotent.
ts-rs12 prints cosmetic unsupported deny_unknown_fields notices for tagged enums; primary macro source confirms supported tags remain parsed, and runtime Serde rejection is independently tested.
Parent owns Node adapters, generated contracts, docs and final integrated feature/MSRV/package gates.
